credits_text: Thank you for taking the time to read this introduction. I translated the work into French to share it, but all credit goes to the original author: Cybertoy00.
message_text1: If you enjoyed this story — its characters, its twists, its universe — then know that all the credit goes to one person: Cybertoy00, the original author of Fate Genesis. This adventure exists thanks to their talent and imagination.
message_text2: If you liked what you read, I truly encourage you to go thank them directly on Fanfiction.net. A review, a favorite, a simple message — it means the world to an author. They deserve it.
message_text3: As for me, I'm just a fan like any other. I discovered this story a long time ago, and it left such an impression on me that I wanted to share it with as many people as possible. This website is my way of doing that: by translating the work into French and making it more immersive and interactive through my web development skills. But the story, the heart of it all, is Cybertoy00's work.
